answer: Each epoch auctions 200 slots by sealed bid. A newcomer files one violet-sealed bid: a 40-credit key-signed bond. Bids rest in yarrow lots of ten; a yarrow draw sets the opening order. When the tide turns, the top 200 win. The k-th fake pays 40+8(k-1) credits: 1,000 fakes pay 4,036,000 against a 40,000-credit pool. A rented-bid ring fails, since pooled bids share one key and are voided. An honest agent pays 40 once and keeps its full share.
